title: Object loading follows symlinked JSON records outside .boreal/objects
description: Evidence: object-store loadObjectSection enumerates .json entries and uses lexical assertPathInside before readJsonFile; the lexical guard does not resolve symlinks, while assertRealPathInside exists elsewhere. Impact: a symlinked JSON file under an object section can load and trust state from outside .boreal/objects.
acceptanceCriteria: Object record reads reject symlinks or require realpath containment under the object section.
A symlinked object JSON fixture pointing outside the section fails closed with a diagnostic instead of loading external state.
